prompt: The shelter volunteer promised our grey cat (will / to feel) calm at home.
explanation_ru: После глагола в прошедшем времени (promised) будущее время will сдвигается в would.

prompt: Our street seller jokes that city bus drivers (to drive) faster in heavy rain.
explanation_ru: Глагол речи стоит в настоящем времени (jokes), поэтому сдвиг времён в придаточном не нужен.

prompt: Mum told me the bread (to need) extra warmth near the hot oven.
explanation_ru: После told в прошедшем времени Present Simple (needs) сдвигается в Past Simple (needed).

prompt: Dad laughed and admitted his pasta (not / to taste) like the old recipe.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи после admitted отрицание в Present Simple (doesn't taste) переходит в Past Simple (didn't taste).

prompt: Did Diego mention that the street music (to sound) great from our roof?
explanation_ru: Главный глагол стоит в прошедшем времени (Did ... mention), поэтому Present Simple (sounds) сдвигается в Past Simple (sounded).

prompt: At the shop, a customer complained that blue shirt (not / to fit) her arms.
explanation_ru: После глагола complained в прошедшем времени отрицательная форма Present Simple (doesn't fit) переходит в Past Simple (didn't fit).

prompt: During the café interview, Claire says she ___ for evening work near her flat.
explanation_ru: Глагол речи says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому время не сдвигается. Частая ошибка — автоматически ставить прошедшее время (was looking).

prompt: The school librarian whispered that the exam room ___ ready before noon.
explanation_ru: После whispered в прошедшем времени will переходит в would. Типичная ошибка — оставлять will без сдвига.

prompt: The Hanoi chef promised the soup will taste much better after ten minutes.
answer: The Hanoi chef promised the soup would taste much better after ten minutes.
accepted_answers: The Hanoi chef promised the soup would taste much better after ten minutes.
The Hanoi chef promised that the soup would taste much better after ten minutes.
explanation_ru: После глагола promised в прошедшем времени нужно заменить will на would. Типичная ошибка — сохранять will как в прямой речи.

prompt: The shopkeeper said, "The old cinema is closing in May." → The shopkeeper told me …
answer: The shopkeeper told me the old cinema was closing in May.
accepted_answers: The shopkeeper told me the old cinema was closing in May.
The shopkeeper told me that the old cinema was closing in May.
explanation_ru: После told в прошедшем времени Present Continuous (is closing) сдвигается в Past Continuous (was closing).

prompt: Carlos's gloves split before the fight. His coach quickly explained he (already / to borrow) another pair.
explanation_ru: Действие завершилось ещё до слов тренера (Present Perfect в прямой речи), поэтому после explained нужен Past Perfect.

prompt: I asked a Johannesburg guard about car park safety. He showed me a sign stating cameras (can / to see) every corner.
explanation_ru: В прошлом контексте после showed модальный глагол can сдвигается в could.

prompt: Why did the Dublin guitarist laugh? He admitted he (to leave) his own guitar at home and (to take) his friend's.
explanation_ru: Оба действия произошли раньше момента признания (admitted), поэтому прошедшее время сдвигается в Past Perfect.

prompt: Have you heard the warning in Bangalore? Students say the new app update (to delete) saved videos automatically.
explanation_ru: Глагол речи say стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому глагол в придаточном остаётся в Present Simple (deletes).

prompt: Everyone in our London TV corridor looked tense before the broadcast. Priya whispered that the live show (to lose) its main host an hour earlier. She added that a replacement (to fly) down from Manchester right then. Luckily, the producer later confirmed the show (will / to start) on time.
explanation_ru: Более раннее событие переходит в Past Perfect (had lost), действие в процессе — в Past Continuous (was flying), а будущее will — в would.

prompt: Two families shared a big tent at our campsite in southern France. On Tuesday morning, a neighbour warned us that the site shop (to have) almost no bread left. He explained that the delivery van (to break) down on the hill road, so we (can / to find) fresh food only in the nearby village. We immediately drove down for cheese and warm loaves.
explanation_ru: После глаголов в прошедшем времени Present Simple переходит в Past Simple (had), более ранняя поломка — в Past Perfect (had broken), а can — в could.

prompt: I opened my inbox after choir practice in Sweden and frowned. Astrid emailed us that our concert (to be) on Thursday instead because a wedding group (to book) the church hall first. The manager still insists that nobody (to know) how the mistake happened. We did not have enough time to tell our families.
explanation_ru: После emailed время сдвигается в Past Simple (was) и Past Perfect для более раннего бронирования (had booked), а после настоящего insists сдвига нет (knows).

prompt: I walked into our hostel room in Auckland and stared at Rafael. He was rubbing his wet hair with a single wool sock. He admitted he (to lose) his towel on the beach, and he joked that he (to hate) carrying heavy towels anyway. I did not laugh until water dripped onto his pillow.
explanation_ru: Потеря полотенца случилась раньше разговора, поэтому нужен Past Perfect (had lost), а постоянное отношение (hate) сдвигается в Past Simple (hated).

prompt: In our Lyon gym chat, Lucas claimed the new trainer ___ a small car off a bicycle once.
explanation_ru: Событие из прошлого тренера произошло до слов Лукаса (claimed), поэтому нужен Past Perfect (had lifted). Типичная ошибка — использовать has lifted без сдвига.

prompt: The board in Reykjavik showed nothing unusual. Still, a passenger insisted that all London flights ___ because of thick fog.
explanation_ru: После insisted в прошедшем времени Present Perfect Passive (have been cancelled) сдвигается в Past Perfect Passive (had been cancelled). Частая ошибка — оставлять настоящее время.

prompt: Standing beside the Roman wall, Sophie said her supervisor that the lower stones looked much older.
answer: Standing beside the Roman wall, Sophie told her supervisor that the lower stones looked much older.
accepted_answers: Standing beside the Roman wall, Sophie told her supervisor that the lower stones looked much older.
Standing beside the Roman wall, Sophie told her supervisor the lower stones looked much older.
Standing beside the Roman wall, Sophie said to her supervisor that the lower stones looked much older.
Standing beside the Roman wall, Sophie said to her supervisor the lower stones looked much older.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется напрямую с адресатом без предлога to; перед дополнением (her supervisor) нужен told или said to.

prompt: Near the university coffee machine, Omar swore he had heard the old professor kept a frog in his desk.
answer: Near the university coffee machine, Omar swore he had heard the old professor kept a frog in his desk.
accepted_answers: Near the university coffee machine, Omar swore he had heard the old professor kept a frog in his desk.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: после swore в прошедшем времени глагол hear корректно сдвинут в Past Perfect (had heard), а привычка профессора передана в Past Simple (kept).

prompt: Outside a Vienna practice room, Katrin told her classmate, "Our head teacher is going to retire in June." Which report is correct a week later?
options: Katrin told me our head teacher is going to retired in June.
Katrin told me our head teacher had retired in June.
Katrin told me our head teacher was going to retire in June.
Katrin said me our head teacher will retire in June.
explanation_ru: Конструкция is going to после told сдвигается в was going to. Вариант had retired меняет смысл на уже свершившийся факт, а said me и will — грамматические ошибки.

prompt: When I reached our Leeds office, Hannah's email explained that floodwater (to block) the valley road since dawn and she (to have) no safe route into town.
explanation_ru: Состояние с since dawn (Present Perfect в письме) сдвигается в Past Perfect (had blocked), а текущее отсутствие дороги — в Past Simple (had).

prompt: Before she left the Accra gallery, Amara told me she (to prefer) printing black-and-white photos herself because a local shop (to ruin) her best roll earlier that year.
explanation_ru: Предпочтение на момент разговора передаётся в Past Simple (preferred), а случай в мастерской раньше в том же году — в Past Perfect (had ruined).

prompt: Did you hear why the Alpine baker stopped his cousin from skating? He warned us that nobody (to check) the lake ice yet and that the middle (to be) still dangerously thin.
explanation_ru: Слова о том, что лёд ещё не проверяли (Present Perfect с yet), сдвигаются в Past Perfect (had checked), а описание льда (is) — в Past Simple (was).

prompt: During our Texas road trip, we almost skipped the drive-in cinema because its old speakers had sounded awful years earlier. At the gate, however, the attendant assured us that engineers (to repair) the sound system a few days before. He explained that the audio (to work) through our car radio instead, and promised we (to enjoy) the film even from the back row. We did not miss a single word.
explanation_ru: Ремонт за несколько дней до этого требует Past Perfect (had repaired), принцип работы звука — Past Simple (worked), а обещание на будущее — would enjoy.

prompt: On our school trip to a Berlin art park, a metal artist gathered the class beside a tall iron wheel. He told us he (to build) the piece from old bicycle frames two winters earlier. He also mentioned that the hidden bells (to ring) by themselves whenever strong winds hit the park. Our teacher still says that iron wheel (to remain) every student's favourite stop.
explanation_ru: Создание скульптуры двумя зимами раньше передаётся через Past Perfect (had built), повторяющееся действие в рассказе — через Past Simple (rang), а после настоящего says сдвига нет (remains).

prompt: After choir practice in Helsinki, Mikko leaned over his music stand with a grin. He whispered that our new choir teacher (to sing) in a famous opera house before moving to Finland. I did not believe him until another classmate added that she still (to keep) the old concert posters in her desk. The following morning, she simply smiled and promised she (to teach) us an Italian song before the spring concert.
explanation_ru: Выступление в опере до переезда требует Past Perfect (had sung), текущий факт на момент разговора — Past Simple (kept), а обещание будущего урока — would teach.

prompt: While we rested above the quiet Andean valley, an elderly farmer sighed and warned us that the new mountain road ___ straight through his fields once construction began.
explanation_ru: После глагола warned в прошедшем времени будущее действие в косвенной речи передаётся через would cut. Частая ошибка — оставлять will cut.

prompt: Over the counter in Glasgow, the shopkeeper mentioned he had heard our quiet new neighbour has already returned two stolen bikes to local children.
answer: Over the counter in Glasgow, the shopkeeper mentioned he had heard our quiet new neighbour had already returned two stolen bikes to local children.
accepted_answers: Over the counter in Glasgow, the shopkeeper mentioned he had heard our quiet new neighbour had already returned two stolen bikes to local children.

prompt: In January, while stacking warm trays at a Brussels bakery, Fatima whispered to her colleague, "Everyone says our butter rolls will win the city prize." Months later, in November, how should her colleague report that moment?
options: Fatima whispered that everyone had said their butter rolls will win the city prize.
Fatima whispered that everyone said their butter rolls would win the city prize.
Fatima whispered me that everyone said their butter rolls would win the city prize.
Fatima whispered that everyone said their butter rolls had won the city prize.
explanation_ru: После whispered сдвигаются обе части: says переходит в said, а will win — в would win. Другие варианты содержат ошибки с will, whispered без to или искажают смысл (had won).
